name: Twitch
label: Twitch Helix API
description: Official Twitch Helix API via OfficialApiNode. Base https://api.twitch.tv/helix. Operations: stream_get, user_get, clip_create, chat_send, trigger (EventSub ingress). Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). extraHeaders send required Client-Id: {client_id}. Failures are output.error. Official API only. https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. stream_get: user_id, user_login. user_get: id, login. clip_create: broadcaster_id. chat_send: broadcaster_id, sender_id, message. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"user_get","login":"twitch"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'stream_get' | 'user_get' | 'clip_create' | 'chat_send' | 'trigger'. trigger is EventSub ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Example: 'user_get'.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Helix user_id query for stream_get. Repeatable on Helix; this node sends one string. Example: '141981764'.

schema.label: user_login
schema.description: Helix user_login query for stream_get. Example: 'twitchdev'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Helix user id query for user_get. Combined with login, Helix max 100. Example: '141981764'.

schema.label: login
schema.description: Helix login query for user_get. Omit id and login → token user (user access token). Example: 'twitchdev'.

schema.label: broadcaster_id
schema.description: Twitch user id of the broadcaster. Required on clip_create and chat_send. Example: 141981764.

schema.label: sender_id
schema.description: Twitch user id of the sender (must match the token user). Required on chat_send.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Chat text. Required on chat_send. Max 500 characters.

schema.label: has_delay
schema.description: clip_create query. true adds a delay so the clip captures the moment the broadcaster clicks. Default false. https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/#create-clip

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Never includes access_token. trigger returns a BPMN message-event instruction. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed Helix JSON (data array, clip edit_url, chat is_sent).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Helix verb. EXACT: stream_get | user_get | clip_create | chat_send | trigger. trigger is BPMN EventSub ingress, not a socket. Default user_get.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Twitch user or app OAuth access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer (StudioQuack secret). Never on INPUT, never logged. Empty → error. Chat send needs a user token with user:write:chat.

configurationParameters.label: Client ID
configurationParameters.description: Twitch application Client-Id. Required by Helix on every call; sent as header Client-Id via extraHeaders. Not a secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Floor 1. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
